evidenceMeaning.DOCUMENTED: Existence, architecture or count is documented; it does not certify fine manufacturing geometry.
evidenceMeaning.VISUALLY_RECONSTRUCTED: Shape and placement reconstructed from NASA hardware photographs or diagrams.
evidenceMeaning.INFERRED: Explanatory internal geometry, approximate board layout, fine conductor routes, pinouts or unrecovered dimensions.

limitations: Exterior represents surface operations without the aeroshell, parachute or bioshield; arm pose is illustrative.
The general deck uses the documented clipped-hexagon structure; its small fixtures, cloth folds and connector dimensions are photographically approximated.
No complete public flight PCB netlists, connector pinouts or detailed optical prescription were recovered. Circuit traces, internal packages and winding geometry are explanatory.

Viking 1 and Viking 2 share this hardware reconstruction; site backgrounds and mission history remain distinct. Viking 1 seismometer hardware is represented without claiming that its failed uncaging produced science data.
Boom elevation and honeycomb crushing demonstrate principles, not a flight simulation or physical-load calculation.
RP-1027 RTG fin width has inconsistent metric/imperial notation (53 cm / 23 in); that secondary width is treated as approximate.

RP-1027 prints TDS tank diameter as 57.9 cm alongside 23.5 in, an inconsistent conversion. The printed metric value is used as nominal, not a CAD measurement. TDS baffles are documented; their shapes are educational. The RCS isolation diaphragm is not reproduced in the TDS tank.
Actual NASA PIA00563 is a low-resolution archival color view; it provides background context, not a simulated panorama.

Rear service loops, mounting feet, drive housings and connector glands are reconstructed from imagery. Their exact dimensions, cable identities and flight pin assignments remain unconfirmed. Display straps and hanging ground plugs in museum/test photos are not surface hardware.
Offline GLB/EGL rendering and DOM/controller tests were performed. Browser pixels, Android hardware and actual FPS were not measured.
